title: QaaS Mocker observability
description: Usage and reliability from reconciled Elasticsearch logs.

list.name: Environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: {"find": "terms", "field": "event.Environment", "query": "event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene}", "size": 1000}

list.name: ExecutionType
list.label: Mode
list.query: {"find": "terms", "field": "event.ExecutionType", "query": "event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene}", "size": 1000}

list.name: Version
list.label: Version
list.query: {"find": "terms", "field": "event.Version", "query": "event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene}", "size": 1000}

list.name: Features
list.label: Feature
list.query: {"find": "terms", "field": "event.Features", "query": "event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene}", "size": 1000}

panels.title: Runs started
panels.description: One observed start per distinct execution attempt in the selected interval.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Runs completed
panels.description: Distinct observed terminal attempts, successful, cancelled or failed. Finish time determines inclusion.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Unsuccessful finishes
panels.description: Sum of non-success flags divided by observed finishes. A missing finish never enters either side. Cancellation is a separate outcome below.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: P95 run duration
panels.description: 95th percentile of individual monotonic durations in milliseconds, over observed finishes. Executions without a measured duration contribute no sample.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Starts by environment
panels.description: Execution starts per time bucket by the framework's CI/local classification. A gap indicates no observed starts.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Finished outcomes
panels.description: Terminal attempts per time bucket by outcome. Compare cancellation, execution errors and test failures to successful finishes.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: No observed finish after 15 min
panels.description: Starts in this range at least 15 minutes before its end, with no terminal by that cutoff. Includes long-running services and lost records. A dash means there are no matching records.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.StartedAt:[* TO "${__to:date:iso}||-15m"] AND ((*:* AND NOT _exists_:event.FinishedAt) OR event.FinishedAt:{${__to} TO *])

panels.title: Finish without observed start
panels.description: Terminal attempts in range for which no start exists in the retained reconciliation data. A dash means no matches.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND NOT _exists_:event.StartedAt

panels.title: Completed runs / s
panels.description: Distinct finishes divided by the selected interval in seconds. The dashboard uses the whole chosen interval, including its quiet periods.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Unknown attribution
panels.description: Starts missing at least one trusted team, project or system. Choose (unattributed) in an owner filter to see these attempts. A dash means no matches.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND (event.TeamKnown:false OR event.ProjectKnown:false OR event.SystemKnown:false)

panels.title: Conflicting replays
panels.description: Distinct reconciliation keys with incompatible copies of one phase or HTTP summary. Conflicting keys are excluded from all other panels; inspect the original logs by attempt or server identity.

targets.query: event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Conflict:true

panels.title: Active teams
panels.description: Estimated distinct known team labels with an observed start in the selected range. This measures usage. No eligible-owner denominator is supplied.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.TeamKnown:true

panels.title: Returning teams
panels.description: Estimated distinct known team labels present in both equal-duration halves of the selected UTC range. Intersection = first + second − union, bounded by the smaller half. If either half has no observed owners, comparison is unavailable.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.TeamKnown:true

script.source: long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() < mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];
long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() >= mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];

panels.title: Active projects
panels.description: Estimated distinct known project labels with an observed start in the selected range. This measures usage. No eligible-owner denominator is supplied.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.ProjectKnown:true

panels.title: Returning projects
panels.description: Estimated distinct known project labels present in both equal-duration halves of the selected UTC range. Intersection = first + second − union, bounded by the smaller half. If either half has no observed owners, comparison is unavailable.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.ProjectKnown:true

script.source: long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() < mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];
long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() >= mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];

panels.title: Active systems
panels.description: Estimated distinct known system labels with an observed start in the selected range. This measures usage. No eligible-owner denominator is supplied.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.SystemKnown:true

panels.title: Returning systems
panels.description: Estimated distinct known system labels present in both equal-duration halves of the selected UTC range. Intersection = first + second − union, bounded by the smaller half. If either half has no observed owners, comparison is unavailable.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.SystemKnown:true

script.source: long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() < mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];
long a=Long.parseLong(params.lo); long b=Long.parseLong(params.hi); long mid=a+(b-a)/2; return doc['event.StartedAt'].value.toInstant().toEpochMilli() >= mid ? [doc[params.axis].value] : [];

panels.title: Usage by team, project and system
panels.description: Observed starts by trusted ownership. Shows the five busiest teams, their five busiest projects and five systems each. Names need not be unique across owners.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Usage by version and mode
panels.description: Observed starts for the eight most active versions and their execution modes. Use the filters to compare a specific release or environment.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Feature use
panels.description: Observed starts by configured, allowlisted capability per time bucket. One attempt can use several features, so series are not additive.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.StartedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Outcomes by team and system
panels.description: Observed finishes and non-success counts per owner. The last column is the non-success fraction, including cancellations. Shows the eight teams and eight systems per team with the most finishes.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Completed requests
panels.description: Sum of completed requests from nonempty server batches. Time is batch publication time.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Handler error rate
panels.description: Processing or response errors, including errors recovered by a fallback. Divided by total completed requests, weighted across batches. Time is batch publication time.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Route miss rate
panels.description: Route/method misses successfully handled by the not-found fallback. Divided by total completed requests, weighted across batches. Time is batch publication time.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: HTTP 5xx rate
panels.description: Responses with status 500–599, including deliberate mocks. Divided by total completed requests, weighted across batches. Time is batch publication time.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: HTTP requests / s
panels.description: Sum of observed request deltas divided by seconds in each UTC histogram bucket. Buckets are at least ten seconds wide to match the reporting period. Counts are attributed to flush time. Empty windows have no observation.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: HTTP outcomes over time
panels.description: Counts per flush-time bucket of at least ten seconds. A handler error may also return 5xx. These series must not be added together.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Busiest HTTP server instances
panels.description: Top 20 server lifetimes by summed requests. Server ID is a drill-down identifier, port is contextual. Distinct handler errors, misses and HTTP 5xx can overlap.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:HTTP AND event.BatchAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}]

panels.title: Recent unsuccessful executions
panels.description: Up to 25 failed or cancelled terminal attempts in descending event time. The attempt ID identifies the matching lifecycle pair in Elasticsearch. Existing application diagnostics retain their usual scope.

targets.query: event.Conflict:false AND event.Team:${Team:lucene} AND event.Project:${Project:lucene} AND event.System:${System:lucene} AND event.Environment:${Environment:lucene} AND event.ExecutionType:${ExecutionType:lucene} AND event.Version:${Version:lucene} AND event.Features:${Features:lucene} AND event.Kind:Execution AND event.FinishedAt:[${__from} TO ${__to}] AND event.Failed:1
